'''Nihal Sailor''' (known professionally and online as '''Nihalsailor''') is an Indian software developer, ethical hacker, and game engineer.<ref>{{cite web |title=Nihalsailor Flagship Portal |url=https://nihalsailor.com/ |access-date=2026-10-07}}</ref> He is the creator and maintainer of several multiplayer gaming systems, real-time communications platforms, and system security tools, including the combat vehicle multiplayer simulator ''WRX Battles Online'', the privacy-focused device utility ''SafeGuard Lite'', and the creative broadcast toolset ''StreamSailor Suite''.<ref>{{cite web |title=The Fleet & Asset Store Archive |url=https://nihalsailor.com/projects.html |website=nihalsailor.com |access-date=2026-10-07}}</ref>

== Career and development ==

Sailor's software engineering focus spans interactive 3D simulations, real-time networking, client-side encryption, and cyber security automation. His digital presence and creative brand are characterized by dark maritime and nautical fantasy motifs under the persona "Captain Nihalsailor".<ref>{{cite web |title=Nihalsailor Official Repository Profile |url=https://github.com/nihalsailor |website=GitHub |access-date=2026-10-07}}</ref>

=== Game development and 3D graphics ===
In game engineering, Sailor utilizes the [[Unity (game engine)|Unity]] engine, [[C Sharp (programming language)|C#]], and [[WebGL]] technologies.
* '''WRX Battles Online''': A high-tempo multiplayer vehicular combat title incorporating dynamic wheel suspension, client-side predictive netcode, weapon ballistics, and destructible vehicle components.<ref>{{cite web |title=WRX Battles Online Repository |url=https://github.com/nihalsailor/WRXBattlesOnline |website=GitHub |access-date=2026-10-07}}</ref>
* '''Ghost Galleon 3D''': A browser-based interactive 3D ocean simulator engineered in [[Three.js]] and custom [[OpenGL Shading Language|GLSL]] shaders, demonstrating GPU Gerstner wave displacement and dynamic buoyancy physics in real time.
* '''Unity Asset Store tools''': Development of modular systems for independent game studios, including dark fantasy user interface kits (''Stuck Cursed UI''), multi-point ocean buoyancy algorithms, and runtime game memory encryption toolsets.

=== Cybersecurity and system software ===
Sailor has engineered several utilities addressing cybersecurity, local policy enforcement, and communication privacy:
* '''SafeGuard Lite''': A lightweight device management and content-filtering application engineered for Android and personal computers. The software utilizes local network packet filtering, application lockouts, and tamper-resistant background daemons to provide parental controls without relying on third-party cloud monitoring.<ref>{{cite web |title=SafeGuard Lite Project Source |url=https://github.com/nihalsailor/ParentralControllApp |website=GitHub |access-date=2026-10-07}}</ref>
* '''ZAI Cyber Threat Radar''': An automated reconnaissance and ethical penetration auditing pipeline built in [[Python (programming language)|Python]] and [[Docker (software)|Docker]] to scan exposed endpoints, inspect open network ports, and correlate findings against known Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) databases.<ref>{{cite web |title=ZAI Security Radar Deployment |url=https://zaimcp.space-z.ai/ |website=Space-Z AI |access-date=2026-10-07}}</ref>
* '''ApaniBaat''': A full-stack real-time communications application engineered with [[Node.js]], [[React (software)|React]], and [[WebSocket]] protocol, providing end-to-end encrypted messaging, media distribution, and presence synchronization.<ref>{{cite web |title=ApaniBaat Realtime Communication |url=https://github.com/nihalsailor/apnibaat |website=GitHub |access-date=2026-10-07}}</ref>
* '''StreamSailor Studio Suite''': An open broadcast orchestration tool written in Python that interfaces with OBS Studio via WebSockets, featuring automated live stream triggers, responsive audio digital signal processing (DSP), and streaming platform telemetry.

== Technical specializations ==

Sailor's primary technical proficiencies include:
* '''Game Engineering:''' Unity 3D engine, C#, multiplayer state synchronization, client-side prediction, GLSL/HLSL custom shaders, and vehicle physics.
* '''Information Security:''' Network penetration testing, endpoint traffic auditing, local packet filtering, and memory tamper resistance.
* '''Web & Distributed Systems:''' WebSockets, Three.js 3D rendering, asynchronous Node.js microservices, and Docker containerization.
